name: ai-video-production-os
description: AI Video Production OS: production skills for video, audio, subtitles, QC and delivery, and the agent that plans with them.

plugins.name: video-production-os
plugins.description: Installs the whole AI Video Production OS: every Skill below except the optional disc-authoring kits, and the routing skill that picks the right one.

plugins.name: video-production-agent
plugins.description: Orchestrator: plans a production and calls the Skills below

plugins.name: ingest-skill
plugins.description: Media offload from cards, recorders and URLs with checksum-verified copies, dual backup and a clip inventory

plugins.name: ffmpeg-skill
plugins.description: Execution engine: typed FFmpeg/ffprobe tools every delegating Skill runs on

plugins.name: video-editing-skill
plugins.description: Cut, trim, concat, fit, overlay

plugins.name: color-grading-skill
plugins.description: Colour correction, LUT, HDR to SDR

plugins.name: motion-graphics-skill
plugins.description: Title cards, lower thirds, overlays

plugins.name: subtitle-skill
plugins.description: Subtitle validation, SRT/WebVTT generation, burn-in

plugins.name: thumbnail-skill
plugins.description: Thumbnail rendering; AI-generated background assets via FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (ADR-012)

plugins.name: blender-skill
plugins.description: Headless Blender: inspect, convert, optimize and render 3D assets (needs Blender installed)

plugins.name: remotion-ffmpeg-skill
plugins.description: Remotion motion graphics on real footage, timed from ffmpeg-skill measurements (captions, jump cuts, beat-synced motion)

plugins.name: hyperframes-skill
plugins.description: Renders HTML scenes to verified video with HyperFrames (needs Node.js 22+ and a headless Chromium)

plugins.name: audio-production-skill
plugins.description: Gain, mix, normalize, dynamics, denoise, filler and silence removal

plugins.name: transcription-skill
plugins.description: Speech to timestamped transcript (local faster-whisper)

plugins.name: diarization-skill
plugins.description: Speaker diarization: fills the Transcript speaker_id that transcription-skill reserves

plugins.name: detection-skill
plugins.description: Face, text (OCR) and object detection

plugins.name: slide-sync-skill
plugins.description: Slide import, slide-change detection, slide text

plugins.name: qc-skill
plugins.description: Rule-based QC: PASS/WARN/FAIL/UNKNOWN

plugins.name: media-analysis-skill
plugins.description: Observation only: measures facts about a media file

plugins.name: artifacts-skill
plugins.description: Verifies AI-generated documents (scripts, caption scripts as documents, reports; caption files belong to subtitle-skill and qc-skill) and issues evidence-backed receipts

plugins.name: imagemagick-skill
plugins.description: Still-image editing with ImageMagick

plugins.name: stepcap
plugins.description: Screen recording of a task into a how-to guide and a SKILL.md
